tickets.subject: Security alert — unusual login from unknown location
tickets.description: I received an email saying my account was accessed from an IP in a country I have never been to. I did not authorize this login. Please investigate and help me secure my account immediately.

tickets.subject: Webhook events are being delivered with 5 minute delay
tickets.description: Our webhook endpoint is receiving events but they are consistently 4-6 minutes late compared to when the events actually occur in the system. This is breaking our real-time pipeline.

tickets.subject: Double charged on last subscription renewal
tickets.description: My credit card was charged twice on the same day for my annual subscription renewal. The amount is $599 and it appears twice on my bank statement dated April 1st. Please refund one charge.

tickets.subject: Add support for webhooks on ticket status changes
tickets.description: We would like to receive a webhook notification whenever a ticket status changes. This would allow us to sync our internal CRM automatically without polling the API every minute.

tickets.subject: Search function returns incorrect results for special characters
tickets.description: When I search for tickets containing ampersands or apostrophes the search returns no results even though I can see matching tickets in the list. For example searching for O'Brien returns nothing.

tickets.subject: Need to transfer account ownership to new admin
tickets.description: Our original account owner has left the company and we need to transfer account ownership to our new IT manager. The current owner is unreachable. Please advise on the process.

tickets.subject: Mobile app freezes when uploading attachments over 5MB
tickets.description: The iOS app completely freezes when I try to attach a file larger than approximately 5MB to a ticket. I have to force-quit the app and the attachment is lost. Tested on iPhone 15 Pro with iOS 17.4.
